answer: Make identities depend on each other in real time. Each epoch, pair agents at random: each must complete a task built on the other's just-produced, unfinished output, a bridge raised from both banks at once. One operator running many clones cannot wander through all those paired exchanges inside the window; the work queues, arrives late, or turns shallow, while honest pairs reach the summit together and on time. Farms serialize. Independent agents parallelize, and the timing gap gives the farm away.
